name: Rap Video Generator
tagline: Turn a photo and an idea into a short rap video.
description: Rap Video Generator turns a photo and a topic—or your own lyrics—into a short vertical rap video. Pick trap, boom bap, melodic, drill, lo-fi or hyperpop, a voice, and a 10 or 15 second clip at 480p or 720p. The song is included in the video price. Ten free signup credits cover a first song; video packs start at $9.99. Adults only; no minors or public figures. Generated music is not licensed copyright-free.
